usage: music-tagger unlock [-h] [--track TRACK] [--disc DISC] [--dry-run]
                           [--log LOG | --no-log]
                           path fields [fields ...]

Unlock fields so `tag` can change them again.

positional arguments:
  path           Album directory.
  fields         Tag fields, e.g. isrc title.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --track TRACK  Only this track number.
  --disc DISC    Only this disc number.
  --dry-run      Show what would change without writing.
  --log LOG      Append changes to this log file (default: $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG,
                 else ~/Projects/music-tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log       Do not write the change log.
